# v6.0.1 — Modules 1–6 synchronization

This patch release aligns the six completed module overviews after the Module 6 release without changing lesson substance, datasets, calculations, visuals, assessments, or capstone results.

## Included

- explicit bidirectional cross-module handoff links across Modules 1–6
- shared Learning Paths and Glossary navigation exposed from every module overview
- repository summary language updated to include customer and supplier relationship management
- durable validator checks that prevent future module-overview navigation drift

## Unchanged

- 330 module Markdown learning/reference pages
- 22 completed sections
- 217 SVG files
- 69 CSV datasets
- 651 independently authored knowledge checks
- six integrated capstones
